acquisition.existing_file_rule: reuse only a decodable existing blinded image and recompute its SHA-256
acquisition.partial_file_rule: delete only the exact measurement_id partial object before the next within-run retry
acquisition.terminal_failure_rule: after four failed attempts record image_acquisition_failed; do not rerun a completed shard to rescue terminal failures
acquisition.interruption_rule: a shard without a terminal CSV and JSON receipt may resume; already complete decodable blinded files are reused under the existing-file rule

measurement.cache_rule: reuse one location-blind photo cache record only when image SHA-256, trained-weight SHA-256 and LF-canonical ROI contract SHA-256 all match
measurement.terminal_failure_rule: retain every acquisition or measurement failure in the 60000-record denominator; never replace an image or species

claim_ceiling: Worker partitioning and technical retry rules only; no image, colour, spatial or environmental outcome.
